name: 8 bit art
subtitle: Pixel stickers. Make your own.
description:
Little pixels. Big feelings. Now your ideas, too.

Bring 67 pixel-art stickers to Messages: cute animals, funny reactions, five takes on 67, and two animated designs. Browse by category, search for a feeling, and keep favorites close. All included stickers, search, and favorites work without Studio Unlock.

MAKE SOMETHING TINY
Optional Studio Unlock adds a native 16×16 editor inside Messages. Start with a blank grid or make one of 45 tiny templates your own. Draw with pencil, eraser, and fill, use undo and redo, then insert your creation into the conversation or export a transparent PNG.

KEEP YOUR LITTLE IDEAS
Save multiple named drafts, reopen them later, and duplicate a favorite starting point. Drawings save on this device as you edit. Export anything you want to keep before deleting the app; restoring a purchase restores the tools, not deleted artwork or drawings on another device.

ONE UNLOCK. YOUR WHOLE STUDIO.
Studio Unlock is an optional, permanent one-time In-App Purchase. No subscription and no charge per drawing or sticker sent. The USA price is US$1.00; other storefronts show Apple's localized price before purchase. Restore Purchases is available under Help. The included sticker collection remains available without buying Studio.

MADE FOR MESSAGES
Open a conversation in Messages, tap + (or the Apps button on older versions), and choose 8 bit art. Look under More if needed. This app lives inside Messages and has no separate home-screen editor. Tap an included sticker to insert it, or touch and hold to place it on a message or photo where supported. You decide when to tap Send.

No app-specific account, advertising, tracking, or developer analytics. Included stickers and saved drawings work on your device; initial purchase and purchase restoration require Apple's services.

Requires iOS or iPadOS 15 or later.
Support: seltzer.wisdom7h@icloud.com.

whatsNew:
Meet Studio, right inside Messages.

• Browse all 67 stickers, including cute reactions, meme-inspired animals, five 67 designs, and two animations.

• Optional Studio Unlock: create on a true 16×16 grid, remix 45 tiny templates, and keep multiple named drafts.

Studio Unlock is a permanent one-time purchase: US$1.00 in the USA, with localized prices elsewhere. No subscription or per-sticker charge. Included stickers, search, and favorites remain usable without it.

Drawings stay on your device. Export work you want to keep before deleting the app.
reviewNotes:
8 bit art, Apple ID 1366485724, is updated from a standalone sticker pack to a custom standalone Messages app on the same record. Published host eu.armand.--bit-art and extension eu.armand.--bit-art.StickerPackExtension are preserved. It has no separate home-screen editor. Requires iOS/iPadOS 15+.

Open Messages, choose a conversation, tap + / More (or Apps on older OS versions), then choose 8 bit art. Collection includes 67 stickers, categories, search, and favorites without Studio Unlock. There are 45 exact-grid 16x16 remix templates and two included APNG stickers. The legacy wine sticker is excluded.

PAID TOOLS: Studio Unlock is one non-consumable In-App Purchase, product ID eu.armand.bitart.studio.unlock, Apple ID 6827336076, USA base price US$1.00. It permanently enables the 16x16 editor, remixing, multiple drafts, creating/inserting custom stickers, and PNG export. No subscription, consumable credits, or charge per send. Submit this first IAP with this new app version. No app-specific account/login or custom test credentials are required.

PURCHASE TEST: Open Studio, tap Try Studio, then Unlock Studio with Apple's localized price. The first requested drawing/remix opens after the verified transaction. Cancel leaves the included collection available. A remix is also available from Collection > sticker Details > Make it yours for one of the 45 tiny templates. Restore Purchases is available in Help under Studio access. App Review purchases use Apple's test environment; production purchases use the App Store. Local mocks and the earlier free beta do not grant ownership in this build.

EDITOR TEST: Draw, fill, undo/redo, rename, return to drafts and reopen, duplicate, and export PNG. Insert sticker adds it to the active conversation composer; the user taps Send. To test restoration, use the same purchase account. Drafts/favorites remain on the device, are not cloud-synced, and deleting the app can remove them. Losing entitlement never deletes existing work; saved work remains viewable/exportable.

Privacy: no advertising, analytics SDK, developer-operated backend, tracking, account system, contacts/photo access, or developer collection of messages/drawings. StoreKit verifies purchases on the device; Apple processes payment. Support and privacy URLs are unchanged. The browser Studio in source is a separate local prototype, not bundled or publicly hosted.

Public version 1.2 (5) is approved and available. This new candidate does not reuse its 46-sticker screenshots. Native Studio screenshots and the IAP review image belong to the 1.4 candidate.
